verdict.rationale: AMD's bundled GAIA software stack emphasizes local, on-device inference that 'keeps your data private, avoids cloud usage fees, and supports air-gapped deployment,' which implicitly prevents user data from leaving the device to be used in cloud AI training. However, there is no explicit statement about an opt-out policy or guarantee that data is never used to train AI models. missing for 10: explicit no-training-on-user-data policy, data governance documentation, independent verification of this privacy claim.
